features: 80W Super Fast Charging for OnePlus – Supports Warp & Dash fast charging up to 80W, delivering quick and efficient power for compatible OnePlus smartphones.
Wide OnePlus Compatibility – Compatible with OnePlus 13/13R/12/12R/11/11R/10 Pro/10R/10T/9RT/9R/8/8T/8R/7/7T/6/6T, Nord series, CE2 Lite, CE3 & CE3 Lite.
Stable & Safe Power Delivery – Built-in smart protection chip ensures over-current, over-voltage, overheating & short-circuit protection for reliable daily use.
Strong & Durable Cable Design – Premium reinforced cable with high-quality connectors resists bending, pulling, and daily wear for long-lasting performance.
USB-A to Type-C Fast Charge Cable – Designed specifically for USB-A chargers and OnePlus fast-charge, ensuring stable charging performance.
description: The 80W USB-A to Type-C Fast Charging Cable is engineered to deliver powerful and reliable charging performance for OnePlus smartphones. Supporting , Warp, and Dash fast-charging technologies, this cable provides up to 80W high-speed charging, helping you power up your device faster and more efficiently. Designed for wide compatibility, it works seamlessly with OnePlus 13, 12, 11, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6 series, as well as Nord and CE series smartphones. The advanced internal smart chip ensures safe and stable power delivery by protecting your device against overheating, over-current, and short circuits. The premium reinforced cable construction with high-quality connectors resists bending, pulling, and daily wear for long-lasting performance.
